newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real ends flat in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real ends flat in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real ended flat at 1.0511 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.

The real was traded between 1.0509 and 1.0513 per greenback throughout most of the session. In late afternoon, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0510 reais each to drain liquidity from the market, dealers said.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real closed at 1.0569 per dollar, down 0.05 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.27 percent at 1.095 per greenback, traders said.
